119.title: /styleqa: one command that runs the measured audit and a bounded visual review into one report
humanItems: Read `docs/agent/styleqa.md`: it tells a project how to adopt Style QA, add a page or a state, read the report,

notes.text: escalated to a fresh judgment-tier builder (round 2): gate: node tools/acceptance-check.mjs --e2e

builder left undone (round 0): The [human] item (browser test prints pass, not SKIP, with Playwright installed) is open. Playwright is not installed here, so sweep.mjs and probe.mjs collectPage have never run in a real browser.

decisions.text: behaviour: run.mjs also takes --root=<folder> and --settings=<json file>. The tests use them to point the engine at the fixture. The plan lists neither flag. The simplest option was to add them and nothing else — reverse: remove the two flags and the fixture-based CLI tests.

behaviour: a missing docs/qa/styleqa-pages.json counts as an empty page map, so the engine prints 'no pages in docs/qa/styleqa-pages.json' and exits 0 — reverse: make loadPageMap throw when the file is absent.

behaviour: an alias that repeats a slug or another alias is refused, including when both are on the same page, and a slug that equals an earlier alias is refused too — reverse: relax the duplicate check in validatePageMap.
behaviour: a finding that was gone and is seen again is reported as new, not known — reverse: keep the old status in mergeRun.

behaviour: S2 and S3 turn off one by one when only one of the colour or font-size prefixes is set. The note says which, e.g. 'S3 off: no font-size token prefix configured'. The plan names only the no-tokens case — reverse: drop the per-check notes.

behaviour: with empty styleqa.stylesheets, every file with the stack's stylesheet extension is scanned, skipping node_modules, .git, dist, build, coverage and .claude — reverse: require the stylesheets setting.
behaviour: the report is written as <outDir>/report.md and the store as <outDir>/known.json — reverse: rename the files in run.mjs.
behaviour: styleqa.widths entries are { width, height } objects, validated at 200–4000 whole pixels — reverse: change the shape in kit.config.json and styleqaProblems.

behaviour: .gitignore is an override in this repo, so sync does not write it. I added '.claude/styleqa/' by hand. A project that moves styleqa.outDir must ignore its own folder — reverse: remove the line.

behaviour: the report redacts with an engine-local module (core/scripts/styleqa/redact.mjs) because core/scripts/lib/redact.mjs only strips Execution Notes from plans — reverse: delete it and the plan's alternative would need a new shared redactor.

behaviour: run.mjs also takes --root=<dir> (default: the folder above scripts/) and --settings=<json file> (styleqa keys laid over the rendered ones, nothing written), so the tests and trial runs can point at the fixture; these flags are not in the plan's list — reverse: drop both flags in core/scripts/styleqa/run.mjs and run the tests against a rendered install

behaviour: a page-map state step is { action, target, value? } (value required for fill and press), every page has the implicit state 'default', and auth is true, false or a ui.logins role word; the plan named the actions but not the step shape — reverse: change STEP_KEYS and the checks in core/scripts/styleqa/pages.mjs and the seed's $comment

behaviour: with styleqa.stylesheets empty, the static checks read every *.<stack.stylesheetExt> file outside node_modules, dist, build, coverage, any dot folder and the output folder — reverse: edit SKIP_DIRS and the dot-folder test in core/scripts/styleqa/static-checks.mjs

behaviour: the report lists every open finding in the store (other pages' too, as the last run left them) plus the findings this run saw go; older gone findings stay only in known.json, and a gone finding that comes back is 'new' again — reverse: change the filter for current in updateStore in core/scripts/styleqa/findings.mjs

behaviour: an empty page map stops the run with 'no pages in docs/qa/styleqa-pages.json' and exit 0 before the static layer runs, as the plan's Technical Considerations say — reverse: move the pages.length check below the static layer in core/scripts/styleqa/run.mjs
seen: tools/test/orchestrator-env-retry.test.mjs:278 '103 (h) git longpaths' fails on base e55bfbc too (expects 'OK git longpaths (set to true)', gets 'OK   git longpaths')
seen: tools/test/run-plans.test.mjs:569 '099 (a) a run writes its own console log' fails on base e55bfbc too (assertion actual false, expected true)

behaviour: idType is read as the list request path (/api/x or a full URL); a bare word such as 'number' gives 'skipped: no record' in coverage — reverse: change recordId() in core/scripts/styleqa/sweep.mjs to build the URL from the word
behaviour: a page with idType also runs the 'empty' state, and a route with a ?query is a tab state named tab-<value> — reverse: edit sweepStatesOf/tabStates in core/scripts/styleqa/pages.mjs

behaviour: the map check runs on every run (static or sweep) and prints 'SKIP map check: no route reader for this stack' when no pack reader is configured — reverse: move the check under sweepOn in core/scripts/styleqa/run.mjs

behaviour: a failed sweep writes report.md with 'Status: failed — <reason>', exits 1 and leaves known.json untouched, so a failure does not mark every finding gone — reverse: update the store before returning in run.mjs
behaviour: the missing-dependency message starts 'sweep layer not installed' so the existing styleqa-pages test still matches — reverse: reword it and update tools/test/styleqa-pages.test.mjs
behaviour: the request guard also aborts HEAD and OPTIONS (every non-GET) — reverse: allow them in guardDecision()

seen: tools/test/styleqa-pages.test.mjs:39 — it asserts the sweep exits 2 with a 'not installed' message, which only holds while Playwright is absent from the kit; it will fail on a machine with Playwright installed

behaviour: measured findings carry no severity, so the summary counts them by number and visual ones by high/medium/low — reverse: add a severity to the measured checks and change summaryLines in merge.mjs

behaviour: run.mjs now also writes <out>/run.json (date, coverage, notes, rails) so merge can redraw the same report with visual findings — reverse: drop that write and have merge append a visual section instead
behaviour: the plan's 'S2/S3 measured finding' is read as a finding of check S2 or S3 for that state and width in the store — reverse: change MIDDLE_CHECKS in queue.mjs

behaviour: the visual confidence threshold is 70 (overridable with --min-confidence) and a page whose review file is malformed keeps its earlier visual findings — reverse: change MIN_CONFIDENCE in merge.mjs
